body: Choose a player. They gain x¢, where x is the number of ¢ they have.

name: 2 of Spades
subtitle: Loot Card
body: Choose another player. Loot x, where x is the number of loot cards in that player's hand.

body: Gain 3¢.

body: Gain 4¢.

name: ? Card
subtitle: Loot Card
body: As you play this, choose an item. This copies one of that item's Tap abilities.

name: A Dime!!
subtitle: Loot Card
body: Gain 10¢.

name: A Lucky Penny!
subtitle: Loot Card
body: Gain 1¢. Rewards are doubled till end of turn.

name: A Nickel!
subtitle: Loot Card
body: Gain 5¢.

name: A Penny!
subtitle: Loot Card
body: Gain 1¢.

name: A Sack
subtitle: Loot Card
body: Loot 3.

name: Ace Of Diamonds
subtitle: Loot Card
body: Gain x¢, where x is the number of monster slots plus the number of loot cards in your hand.

name: Algiz
subtitle: Loot Card
body: Choose a player. Each item they control gains eternal till end of turn.

name: Ansuz
subtitle: Loot Card
body: Look at the top 4 cards of a deck and put them back in any order.

name: Berkano
subtitle: Loot Card
body: Destroy an item. If that item was controlled by a player, they steal an item from the shop.

name: Black Heart
subtitle: Loot Card
body: Choose a player. Prevent the next 1 damage they would take this turn. Till end of turn, when that player dies, deal 2 damage to each player other than that player and you.

name: Black Rune
subtitle: Loot Card
body: Roll- 1-2: Deal 1 damage to each monster. 3-4: Reroll an item. 5-6: Discard your hand, then loot 3.

name: Blank Rune
subtitle: Loot Card
body: Roll- 1: Each player gains 1¢. 2: Each player loots 2. 3: Each player takes 3 damage. 4: Each player gains 4¢. 5: Each player loots 5. 6: Each player gains 6¢.

name: Bomb!
subtitle: Loot Card
body: Deal 1 damage to a Monster or Player.

name: Butt Penny!
subtitle: Loot Card
body: Gain 1¢, then roll.

name: Butter Bean!
subtitle: Loot Card
body: Cancel the Tap or ¢ ability of an item or a loot being played.

name: Charged Penny
subtitle: Loot Card
body: Gain 1¢, then recharge an item.

name: Cracked Key
subtitle: Loot Card
body: Choose a non-eternal item. It becomes a room. Expand room slots by 1 and put it in the new slot.

name: Credit Card
subtitle: Loot Card
body: The first shop item a player purchases this turn costs 0¢.

name: Dad's Note
subtitle: Loot Card
body: Choose up to 3 non-event monster cards in discard. Put them in one or more monster slots not being attacked.

name: Dagaz
subtitle: Loot Card
body: Choose one- Destroy a curse. / Choose a player. Prevent the next 1 damage they would take this turn.

name: Dice Shard
subtitle: Loot Card
body: Choose a dice roll. Its controller rerolls it.

name: Ehwaz
subtitle: Loot Card
body: Put each monster not being attacked into discard and replace each with the top card of the monster deck.

name: Emergency Contact
subtitle: Loot Card
body: Cancel an attack on a monster and put that monster card on the bottom of the monster deck.

name: Era Walk
subtitle: Loot Card
body: Roll- Change the result of the next 4 dice rolls to this result.

name: Get Out Of Jail Card
subtitle: Loot Card
body: Other players can't play loot cards or activate items till end of turn.

name: Gold Bomb!!
subtitle: Loot Card
body: Deal 3 damage to a monster or player.

name: Gold Key
subtitle: Loot Card
body: The active player may attack the monster deck any number of times till end of turn.

name: Hagalaz
subtitle: Loot Card
body: Look at the top 5 cards of the monster or room deck and put them back in any order, then put a room or monster not being attacked into discard.

name: Holy Card
subtitle: Loot Card
body: Choose a player. The next time that player would die this turn, prevent death. If it's their turn, cancel everything that hasn't resolved and end it.

name: I. The Magician
subtitle: Loot Card
body: Change the result of a dice roll to a number of your choosing.

name: II. The High Priestess
subtitle: Loot Card
body: Choose a player or monster, then roll- Deal damage to them equal to the result.

name: III. The Empress
subtitle: Loot Card
body: Choose a player. They gain +1 ATK and +1 to dice rolls till end of turn.

name: IV. The Emperor
subtitle: Loot Card
body: Look at the top 5 cards of the monster deck. Put 1 on top and the rest on the bottom.

name: IX. The Hermit
subtitle: Loot Card
body: Look at the top 5 cards of the treasure deck. Put 1 on top and the rest on the bottom.

name: Jera
subtitle: Loot Card
body: Loot x, where x is equal to the number of loot cards in your hand.

name: Joker
subtitle: Loot Card
body: Look at a player's hand. You may steal a loot card from them.

name: Key
subtitle: Loot Card
body: Choose one- The active player may attack an additional time this turn. Put the top card of the monster deck in a monster slot not being attacked.

name: lil Battery
subtitle: Loot Card
body: Recharge an item.

name: Magic Marker
subtitle: Loot Card
body: Change a number in the effect text of a card in play or loot being played by 1 till end of turn. The number can't go below 1 or above 6.

name: Mega Battery
subtitle: Loot Card
body: Choose a player. Recharge each item they control.

name: Mega Bean!
subtitle: Loot Card
body: Cancel the Tap, ¢, or triggered ability of an item or loot being played that targets you or something you control. If you do, deal 2 damage to the player who controlled the item or loot being played.

name: Mega Bomb!
subtitle: Loot Card
body: Deal 2 damage to a monster or player.

name: Mugger Bean!
subtitle: Loot Card
body: Cancel a loot being played and put it in your hand.

name: Perthro
subtitle: Loot Card
body: Reroll an item.

name: Pills!
subtitle: Loot Card
body: Roll- 1-2: Loot 3. Then put 3 cards from your hand on top of the loot deck in any order. 3-4: Loot 3. Then put 1 card from your hand on top of the loot deck. 5-6: Loot 3.

name: Soul Heart
subtitle: Loot Card
body: Choose a player. Prevent the next 1 damage they would take this turn.

name: Sticky Nickel
subtitle: Loot Card
body: Roll- 1-3: Give this to the player to your left. 4-6: Gain 5¢.

name: Two Of Diamonds
subtitle: Loot Card
body: Double the number of ¢ a player has.

name: V. The Hierophant
subtitle: Loot Card
body: Choose a player or monster. Prevent the next instance of up to 2 damage they would take this turn.

name: VI. The Lovers
subtitle: Loot Card
body: Choose a player. They gain +2 HP till end of turn.

name: VII. The Chariot
subtitle: Loot Card
body: Choose a player. They gain +1 ATK and +1 HP till end of turn.

name: VIII. Justice
subtitle: Loot Card
body: Choose a player. Loot and gain ¢ until you have the same number of each as they do.

name: X. Wheel Of Fortune
subtitle: Loot Card
body: Roll- 1: Gain 1¢. 2: Take 2 damage. 3. Loot 3. 4. Lose 4¢. 5: Gain 5¢. 6: Gain +1 treasure.

name: XI. Strength
subtitle: Loot Card
body: Choose a player. They gain +1 ATK till end of turn and may attack an additional time this turn.

name: XII. The Hanged Man
subtitle: Loot Card
body: Look at the top card of each deck. You may put any of those cards on the bottom of their deck, then loot 2.

name: XIII. Death
subtitle: Loot Card
body: Kill a player.

name: XIV. Temperance
subtitle: Loot Card
body: Choose one- Take 1 damage and gain 4¢. Take 2 damage and gain 8¢.

name: XIX. The Sun
subtitle: Loot Card
body: Put this on the bottom of the loot deck. If you do, take an extra turn after this one if it's your turn.

name: XV. The Devil
subtitle: Loot Card
body: Destroy an item you control. If you do, steal a non-eternal item from a player or from the shop.

name: XVI. The Tower
subtitle: Loot Card
body: Roll- 1-2: Each player takes 1 damage. 3-4: Each monster takes 1 damage. 5-6: Each player takes 2 damage.

name: XVII. The Stars
subtitle: Loot Card
body: Gain +1 treasure.

name: XVIII. The Moon
subtitle: Loot Card
body: Look at the top 5 cards of the loot deck. Put 1 on top and the rest on the bottom.

name: XX. Judgement
subtitle: Loot Card
body: Choose the player with the most souls or tied for the most. That player destroys a soul they control.

name: XXI. The World
subtitle: Loot Card
body: Look at each player's hand, then loot 2.

name: Lost Soul
subtitle: Lost Soul Card
body: When this enters play, gain +2 treasure and give this to another player. It becomes a soul.
